advice: Right hand leaps up an octave — D#5 to D#6. Practise the jump silently first: eyes find D#6 before the hand leaves D#5, then add sound once the distance feels automatic.

Right hand chord D#4+D#5 — shape the hand in the air before landing, and let the top note D#5 sing above the others.
Mostly black keys here (D#5, D#4) — play nearer the fallboard where the black keys sit, with firm curved fingertips.
Marked p — decide the sound before the bar begins and let the arm weight, not finger force, make the change.

practiceNotes: Slow practice: one chunk clean, then add the next. Never rush the join.
